text: Deployed and verified on 26 November 2026 in the AWS Academy Cloud Developing sandbox (us-east-1) with one command from AWS CloudShell: 14/14 pre-flight checks passed, the CloudFormation stack reached CREATE_COMPLETE, /health returned HTTP 200 from outside AWS, unauthenticated API calls were refused (401), and a leave approval on the live site started the worker Lambda through SQS (Figure 7). Two defects that only a real deployment could reveal (an empty SAM parameter and an SQS policy statement naming two queues) were fixed and redeployed. The sandbox deletes resources when its session ends, so the stack is re-created for each demonstration.
